description:
Clean up a messy presentation draft by fixing layout errors on 4 specific slides.

1. **Slide 1 (Title)**: The main title "Nebula Platform Launch" is left-aligned. Change alignment to **Center**.
2. **Slide 2 (Features)**: The bullet list is too long and overflows off the slide. Format the text box to use **2 Columns**.
3. **Slide 3 (Pricing)**: The "Enterprise Plan" box covers the title. Move it down so it is visible in the body area.
4. **Slide 4 (Contact)**: The email address is too small. Increase the font size to **24pt**.

Save the result as `~/Documents/Presentations/product_launch_fixed.odp`.
